company.name: Pangea
company.shortDescription: Hire top fractional marketers and designers.
company.description: For companies looking for high-quality, flexible specialists, Pangea unlocks a network of vetted, fractional talent - primarily marketers, designers, and operators.  Pangea has helped more than 6,000 companies connect with top fractional talent.  Our tech-powered process enables us to connect you with talent in 24 hours or less.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that connects businesses with vetted fractional marketing and design professionals for flexible, part-time engagements.
productsAndServices.name: Fractional Marketing and Design Talent Hiring Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven system that matches businesses with suitable fractional marketing and design professionals based on project requirements and candidate profiles.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Talent Matching Algorithm

productsAndServices.description: A service acting as the legal employer for global fractional talent, ensuring compliance with international labor laws and simplifying cross-border hiring.
productsAndServices.name: Employer of Record (EOR) Service

productsAndServices.description: A service that integrates Pangea’s platform with clients’ Vendor Management Systems to streamline billing and payment processes.
productsAndServices.name: Integrated Vendor Management System (VMS) Billing

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows clients to schedule interviews with candidates quickly and conduct them via secure, integrated video call rooms.
productsAndServices.name: Interview Scheduling and Video Call Rooms

productsAndServices.description: A built-in project management tool that allows clients to assign tasks, track progress, and monitor freelancer hours within the platform.
productsAndServices.name: Project and Task Management for Freelancers

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 67% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,247,337 to $12,980,495, a 5.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
